record.title: What we'll ask at the first visit
record.why: "How a planting plan comes together" covers the drawing stage, but nothing helps a reader prepare for or brief the studio before any drawing starts.
record.notes: Write it as the list of real questions the studio asks on site ("Is there a dog who digs?", "Where does the water sit in February?", "Who's actually going to weed it?"), with a line on why each one matters. The reader is someone about to book, and the piece should help them turn up with answers and with photos taken in different seasons. End with a low-key offer, something like the kettle being on. [Need: the studio's actual consultation questions and what the first visit includes.]
